arxiv-2303-02517.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by K. El Bourakadi 1,2. This article investigates the effects of Tree Level Higgs Potential on reheating in f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity. We examine the formalism of tree level inflation in a modified f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) model, finding that the slow roll and e-folds number during inflation depend on the f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) model α \alpha parameter. pmc-11509222.title: Short-Term Visual and Refractive Outcomes of Single-Step Transepithelial Photorefractive Keratectomy with Amaris 750S and SmartSurfACE in Myopia and Astigmatism: A 6-Month Follow-Up Study
pmc-11509222.creator: Daiana-Andreea Margarit, Horia Tudor Stanca, Valeria Mocanu, Mihnea Munteanu, Suta Marius, Suta Gheorghita
pmc-11509222.description: Background: Single-step transepithelial photorefractive keratectomy (TPRK) is a modern refractive surgery technique that offers a no-touch approach for correcting myopia and astigmatism. This study aims to evaluate the short-term visual and refractive outcomes of TPRK in patients with myopia and astigmatism over a 6-month follow-up period.

pmc-12642988.title: Isolation, identification and subsequent application of Gram-positive bacterial strains for the bioremediation of benzophenone
pmc-12642988.creator: Amna Maqsood, Shahid Mahmood, Azeem Khalid, Irfan Aziz, Rab Nawaz, Marlia Mohd Hanafiah, Birthe Veno Kjellerup
pmc-12642988.description: Benzophenone (BZP) is a persistent environmental pollutant that can induce serious negative effects on the human health and aquatic life. Because of its hydrophobic nature and resistance to natural degradation, it tends to bioaccumulate in the aquatic ecosystem. The present study was aimed at developing an efficient bioremediation system for the degradation of BZP in wastewater.

pmc-12680869.title: Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 inhibitor (SGLT2i) Prescription Rates Amongst Diabetologists for Type 2 Diabetes Patients with Albuminuric Diabetic Kidney Disease: A Real-World Study at a Diabetes Center in Bangkok

pmc-12731866.title: Anatomical Determinants of Tracheal Breathing Sounds: A Computational Study of Airway Narrowing and Obstructive Sleep Apnea
pmc-12731866.creator: Walid Ashraf, Jeffrey J Fredberg, Zahra Moussavi, Cheng-Yu Tsai
pmc-12731866.description: Background: Tracheal breathing sounds (TBS) have demonstrated strong potential as a non-invasive, wakefulness-based diagnostic tool for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA); yet the relationship between specific upper airway anatomical features and the resulting TBS spectra remains insufficiently understood. This study aims to enhance the diagnostic utility of TBS in OSA by investigating how the upper airway anatomy influences TBS spectral characteristics.

pmc-12988819.title: Child‐Directed Speech in Rural and Urban Households in a Low‐SES Afrikaans‐Speaking Community in South Africa
pmc-12988819.creator: Carmen Defty, Frenette Southwood
pmc-12988819.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Most studies on child language acquisition occur in the minority world (countries which make up the minority of the world's population). Their findings are not generalizable to majority‐world contexts, where the majority of the world's population lives. The limited research in the latter contexts reveals the presence of differing child language socialization practices, not generalizable across Global South contexts, and that socio‐economic status (SES) and geographic location (rural/urban) can affect these practices.

pmc-13475934.title: Understanding Social Media Strategies to Improve Engagement in and Equitable Dissemination of Online Cancer Nutrition Information: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13475934.creator: Ellie Harrison, Sara Buzali-Soto, Eileen Rillamas-Sun, Heather Greenlee, Echo L Warner
pmc-13475934.description: BackgroundSocial media is a common source of cancer information for patients, caregivers, and survivors. Factors influencing engagement with oncology nutrition content on social media are not well-defined, despite the high prevalence of social media use for health information. The impact of bilingual content strategies on that engagement is also poorly understood.
